WoW: Forever

Holy Paladin

Plate-wearing single-target healer with party-wide Blessings and auras, and Forever finally gives it an area-healing answer through the new Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange100 yd rangeDuration30 secThe caster's next Holy Shock on this target will activate Light's Vigil, healing the target and their party for 324. capstone.

WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated October 16, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70374 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Holy build has been tested. Talents open at level 10. The one-point gold medal talents sit at 11, 21 and 31 points spent, joined in Forever by a new 16-point gold medal, and Dual Specialization unlocks at 40. Blizzard's own caveat: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

Blizzard's Paladin deep dive went up on October 15 and this page is rewritten from it. Paladin was the last class without one, so everything here previously came from the three guide sites and the beta client. Where the dive speaks, the claim below is Blizzard's and says so. Every figure here was re-read against client build 1.60.1.70374 on October 16, so the hover tooltips and the build: stamp above are the same client. Where the dive and the client disagree, the figure printed below is Blizzard's and the client's reading follows it in the same sentence.

A published level-20 "Holy damage" build spends two points on Improved Holy StrikeImproved Holy StrikeTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 2 sec.. Blizzard's September 24 notes dropped Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage.'s cooldown to 10 seconds for everyone, and the client's own Holy Strike row confirms the 10 seconds. The talent is still in the client on top of that, taking two seconds off the cooldown, so it was not folded into the class the way this page previously read it. The deep dive does not mention it in any spec's list, the removals included. A client record is not proof the tree can still reach a talent, so treat those two points as spendable and confirm them in game.

Three kinds of caveat run through these pages and they do not mean the same thing. Something marked as ours is our own reasoning rather than a source's. A client or guide-site reading is a number Blizzard has not published. Salvation and Improved Lay on Hands are the third case: Blizzard has published them and the game does not show them. The dive's own note on the Salvation change says it "is not yet live and is going into a future beta build", and the client still carries Blessing of SalvationBlessing of SalvationLevel 26 · Spell · HolyCastInstantRange30 yd rangeDuration3600 secPlaces a Blessing on the party member, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. as a Blessing at level 26 while holding no row at all for Salvation, Mass Salvation or Improved Lay on Hands.

No source has posted a level 30 build either. The cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three sites has published one since. So the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs; no guide recommends it.

What Holy is for

Keeping a party standing while in plate, with the mana tools to keep doing it. Blizzard's own summary is that Holy sustains heals on a single target better than anything else in the game, that healing a whole party at once takes more planning, and that the new talents make Holy a viable healer across every form of group play. ReverenceReverenceTalentCastInstantAllows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. keeps 30% of your Spirit-driven mana regeneration running while you cast. IlluminationIlluminationTalentCastInstant refunds 50% of a spell's base cost when it procs.

The new Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange100 yd rangeDuration30 secThe caster's next Holy Shock on this target will activate Light's Vigil, healing the target and their party for 324. capstone is the party-healing half of that. Mark an ally and their whole party gets healed, and your Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 134 Holy damage to an enemy, or 114 healing to an ally. on them costs you no cooldown.

Underneath all of that you are still a melee Paladin: keep a seal up and press Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage. and JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. on cooldown. Blizzard made that easier to hold together. JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. no longer consumes your active Seal, and Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage. trains at level 6 for 50% of your weapon damage plus a flat Holy bonus that grows with each rank, though the rank you actually train there reads 25% of weapon damage plus 12 Holy in the client, on a 10-second cooldown.

Forever cut dungeon experience hard, and the October 1 notes halved the extra experience on dungeon quests as well. That closes Holy's usual escape hatch: "just level in dungeons" is largely gone.

No source publishes a levelling score for any Paladin spec. A score would only measure solo kill speed, not whether the spec works.

Our own reading, not a sourced one: most of what Holy produces lands on other people, because the Blessings, auras and heals all apply to the party. The tree does buy damage now, and that part is Blizzard's: Consecrated GroundConsecrated GroundTalentCastInstantGives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration., Holy PowerHoly PowerTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by 15%, and all other spells by 5%. and Divine PrecisionDivine PrecisionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%. all feed Holy spell damage, and the dive says Holy gains new tools for spell-focused damage.

Stat priority

Healing Power, then Intellect, MP5, critical strike, Haste, Spirit.

If you are not planning to heal seriously, gear Weapon Damage, Hit and critical strike instead and play the Holy-damage path.

Blizzard says it does not plan to itemize Hit chance on plate healing gear, and that Divine PrecisionDivine PrecisionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%. is there to supply it instead: up to 18% Hit with Holy spells, in row 5 behind Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 134 Holy damage to an enemy, or 114 healing to an ally.. On the Holy-damage path that talent is where your spell Hit comes from, not your gear.

At level 60

Unknown: whether the Holy-damage "Shockadin" path holds up as a raid specialisation. Blizzard clearly intends it to exist.
